verdict.rationale: Riveter lets users build enrichments from natural-language prompts (e.g. "Research each company") rather than only structured specs, and it exposes an MCP server/connector so it can be operated directly from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP-compatible AI assistant, effectively giving natural-language command access. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of NL command usage beyond vendor docs, and no worked example of a full conversational session issuing varied natural-language commands.
